title: Exploring the Influence of Label Aggregation on Minority Voices: Implications for Dataset Bias and Model Training

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing class distributions and downstream model predictions (using BERT and RoBERTa) across different label aggregation strategies (majority vote, expert opinion, minority vote) to measure how minority annotator perspectives are silenced or under-represented in ground-truth labels.

Evaluating model performance on hierarchical sexism detection datasets (EDOS and GE) to determine how standard label aggregation strategies affect the recognition of nuanced forms of misogyny and sexism, such as dehumanization, backhanded compliments, and condescending explanations.
